scenarios.name: Hide and show a solid using the active view commands

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user copies Primary as BrowserView and activates the copied view
The MCAD Software has a part containing one solid body
the user chooses All Hidden from the active view context menu
the solid body is not displayed in the viewport
the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser
the user chooses All Visible from the active view context menu
the solid body is displayed in the viewport
the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser
